LESSON: THE CALL OF DISCIPLES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: The Call of Disciples

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Call of Disciples. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
2. state how different people are called to serve God today

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: THE CALL OF DISCIPLES
This lesson teaches The Call of Disciples for Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. state how different people are called to serve God today
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe The Call of Disciples using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about The Call of Disciples above.
2. Explain The Call of Disciples to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand The Call of Disciples.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Call of Disciples with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is The Call of Disciples important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
2. state how different people are called to serve God today

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
